blockingIssues.description: Required cells are computed as scenario command keys intersected with run comparators. If a scenario omits rg/ugrep command templates, those missing comparator cells are never treated as required, so validation still passes incomplete per-scenario matrices.

Harness enforcement mirrors the same subset logic (also at line 994), while comparator/template absences are still represented as skipped 'No command template' cells (lines 536 and 877). This preserves the prior failure mode for omitted comparator templates.

The fix codifies partial-scenario acceptance via test_validate_manifest_passes_for_partial_scenario (including explicit 'No rg/ugrep commands — they are NOT required' and assert-ok behavior), which conflicts with the original review failure and VAL-BENCH-001 full-matrix semantics.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Make comparator completeness policy explicit: each benchmark scenario must define and execute the full required comparator set (ag, rust-ag, rg, ugrep), and missing comparator templates/cells are always blocking failures.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Fix review benchmark-harness-scenario-matrix-equivalence-fix found implementation/tests permitting partial scenario comparator subsets, conflicting with VAL-BENCH-001 and existing library comparator-set language.
